title: One move in alternating play
statement: Given strategies $s_1,s_2 : 	ext{List}(	ext{Bool})\to	ext{Bool}$ and a finite Boolean history $h$, one move extends $h$ by the bit chosen by $s_1$ when $h$ has even length and by $s_2$ when $h$ has odd length.
